bio: Adam Lawrence was the seventh child of William Lawrence Jr. and Deborah Smith, a daughter of Bull Smith, which makes him John's 1st cousin 10 times removed. He served as a member of the State Legislature and as High Sheriff of Queens. He died in 1780, leaving children Deborah (Mrs S. Van Wyck), Sarah (Mrs James Hewlett), Catharine (Mrs Platt), Dr. Daniel, Stephen, Joseph, Clark and George.
